translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Yesu Wisikae Wieke
Sodao sakoropka, kepe mi qaelukke, eŋe panamanka paki, Maria Magdalena eŋe deŋesereo arike, paki kaki wesi kem aŋaine numa wake, waketko kito wongeu metke, yewa mo ma qe rodigeu arike.
Eŋe yale kaki paki biririke, Saimon Petoro so Yesu medeune mane eŋaneka simile kamaŋke, erano ari etane rake, “Eŋe Waom mo kemgo ŋine ma arimi, paki mo ŋene mi detmaine, eŋe diawao ma ari birakemi!”
Yale etangiso, Petoro so medep kimaine ere mat qelige deŋesereo arikoik.
Ŋei etke eretnarek biririkkoik, ŋo medeppa mane oŋo yemo togogoleka biririke, Petoro biraka ari deŋesereo esatka lewine lotkeke.
Paki eŋe kuge ket pore kaki, laplappa ea ka metke, ŋo eŋe kem koto mi waketke.
Eŋane ŋadino Saimon Petoro arike, eŋe oŋo wa yemo koboboineka ariso, kem koto waketke. Waket kaki lap lappa kawet kakoi, eaka yewa pake,
so lap lap mane Yesu wane lewino kawetkakoi, yewa pake. Lap lap yewa yemo lap lap natne kawet kakoi, yewarop mi pake, midaka, eŋe oŋomka walipkawareso pake.
Pakiso medeune mane mikepka deŋesereo lotkeke, eŋe yaleka kem koto waketke, waket kaki paki detluke malip kake.
Ere Anutu wane papiao don mane iwa yale rake, yewa mi detkoik, “Eŋe seu seuoŋine wisikae wieake.”
Pakiso medewetkine ere zinge matko arikoik.
Yesuŋo Maria Magdalena Matkoŋine Wakonkake
Maria eŋe deŋesere wazaino aroke okorake. Arokma arokmaso kuge kem koto potki waketke.
Eso pore otki aŋelo etke yewa metkoik, takot etne libekaŋo auwik paki, Yesu wane pareŋine pake yewa metkoik, mane lewine pake yewa metkiso, mane kine pake yewa metke.
Ere qesonka rakoik, “Ŋerep, ge onoka wane arokmaine.” Eŋe etane rake, “Eŋe naŋane Waom mo ma arimi, paki mo na mi detmaile, eŋe diao ma ari birakemi!”
Maria eŋe don iwa raki paki, zinge pore kaki Yesu yewa okorake, ŋo eŋe Yesuŋo okorake, ea mo mi detke.

Yesuŋo qesonka rake, “Ŋerep, ge onoka wane aroke gemaine? Ge maŋane zuaŋka gemaine?” Ŋerep eŋe wetke rake, eŋe eu ware wareŋo mane, raki paki mo qesonka rake, “Suaine, goŋo ma arineo, yemo ma ari diao birakene, nolatnom detpe paki mo baŋ ari mawe.”
Yesuŋo olale rake, “Maria!” Eŋe zinge Yesu wanoken ari Hebru dongo rake, “Raboni!” Kine ea “Kito ŋebo ŋebon.”

Yesuŋo olale rake, “Solano misuk neukene, onoka wane na zinge Magak wano mane mi wele, ea wane. Ŋo naŋane kimakopne eŋano arinom paki, naŋane edannom, na mo zinge eŋano wamaile, eŋe naŋane Magane so ŋinane Magaŋine, naŋane Anutu.”
Eso Maria Magdalena eŋe ari Waom marat kaki don iwa olatke, ea wane dokoine edange.
Yesuŋo Dokoine Wakon Onge

Soda rarap yewao Yesu dokoine eŋe wekuenoka ari qeturage more, mat mane wane kotino wa madet togole mau kiki metkoi, onoka wane eŋe Yuda ŋei ŋetne eŋane kaet ongi, yale okangoi. Pakiso Yesu eŋe sariki paki keueno okora edane rake, “Peamŋo ŋinano payake.”
Don iwa raki paki, ea wane ŋadino meteretkine so ŋorok ŋorokine ea sikanonge. Paki dokoine eŋe Waom kau paki, oi bakomŋo kotoene watkeke.
Pakiso Yesu eŋe koso manerop edane rake, “Peamŋo ŋinano payake, Magakŋo na talenange, eso noŋo ŋine yaleka tale ŋunmaile.”
Eŋe don iwa raki paki, asuine puangi kotoeno ketki rake, “Ŋine Asu Koboboine mau.
Ŋine ŋei eŋane borikineene ra mataliu, eŋe mo siuke eboniake, ŋo mi ra matalikeiwo, eŋe pa eboniake.”
Tomas Eŋe Yesu Kake
Dokoine 12 eŋano ŋine mane Tomas, eŋetine mane Aitiksipo, eŋe eŋerop mi metki, Yesu eŋe wakononge.

Eso dokoine natne eŋe Tomas olale rakoi, “Ŋene Waom mo kene!” Tomasŋo edane rake, “Na deneŋo biriŋ lopotne meteretkino mi kaikale, so zolipneŋo lopot yewa mi uakakale, so metene ŋorok ŋorokino mi ma desikaleo, na baŋ mi malip kaikale.”

Kaiwe mama sewen(7) qoeki ŋadino soda mane, Yesu dokoine eŋe koso sari mat koto lewage metkoi, eso yewao wamo Tomas weneŋ metkoi. Eŋe madet togole kitokoi, ŋo siluŋ Yesu eŋe sariki paki, keueno okora more rake, “Peamŋo ŋinano payake.”
Pakiso Tomas olale rake, “Zolipŋone iwa motnom paki, naŋane mete retkene kanom paki, meteŋone bira more ŋorok ŋorokno motnom, wetŋone etkeka yewa qeligenom paki, malip nannom!”
Tomas olale rake, “Naŋane Waomne so naŋane Anutune!”
Yesuŋo olale rake, “Ge malip nanmaine, yemo onoka wane mida, yemo ge mo nanmaine, ea wane me? Ŋei ŋerep eŋe mi nanbi paki, malipnan okanmami, eŋe wetpese desikei!”
Yohaneŋo Buk Iwa Qekane Kine
Yesu eŋe urata togogole loutne natne dokoine ŋenane kaitzo ma okange, yewa buk iwa wane kotino mi qewarekole.

Qekole, iwa korop yemo ŋine Yesu eŋe Mesia, eŋe Anutuŋo ŋei ŋerewekoune borikino ŋine ebuyakane birakaki sarike, eŋe Anutu wane Gipole, ŋine don iwa maine detluk kaikei, paki malipkakei ŋine ea wane ra more, ŋine maine eŋine eŋetko gege togon marat kaikei.
